data.one_liner: ScrollController that supports scrolling to an index and listening to index changes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom ScrollController implementation that allows scrolling a list view directly to a specific item index. It also exposes callbacks and listeners to detect when the current visible index changes during scrolling.
use_when: You need to programmatically scroll a ListView or ScrollView to a specific item index.
You need to track which item index is currently visible or active during user scrolling.
avoid_when: You are using a non-scrollable UI layout.
You do not need index tracking or scroll-to-index capabilities.
strengths: Supports scrolling to a specific index easily.
Allows listening to index changes both programmatically and via user scroll.
Supports fixed item sizes as well as variable item sizes via wrappers.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping list items with specific widgets (AnchorItemWrapper) unless using fixed sizes.
Adds extra overhead to standard list management.
